newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 29.33 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 29.33 bln levs 1- and 4-wk T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry on Monday sold two discount T-bill issues with maturities of one week and four weeks, yielding 3.83 percent and 17.69 percent to maturity, respectively, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total of 29.333 billion levs of T-bills and the ministry approved all bids.
The issues were offered with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance by the ministry. Auction date and maturity date for each issue overlap.
Details of the issues follow. Prices are in percent of par:
Bids received 16,114.7 million levs 13,218.6 million levs
Bids approved 16,114.7 million levs 13,218.6 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 3.83 pct 17.69 pct @
